optimization_strategy.bottleneck: [memory/layout-transform bound] The conv mainloop (58.8%) is already at SOL (~296us/conv = 261 TFLOPS TF32 vs 223 measured peak), but its satellite `elementwise_kernel` layout copies hold 15.4% steady (1858us/36 launches = 155us per forward) doing zero math: x->channels_last plus two OIHW->OHWI weight permutes, whose strided TensorIterator gathers waste read sectors.
optimization_strategy.primary_optimisation_method: Replace the three PyTorch TensorIterator permute-copies with ONE custom shared-memory tiled NCHW->NHWC transpose kernel (32x32 tile, +1 padding) so both the read (32 contiguous S elements) and the write (32 contiguous C elements) are 128B-coalesced. Justification E2: identical semantics, same bytes, but removes the sector-utilization loss of the stride-S/stride-9 gather that makes these no-math kernels cost 2-4x their DRAM-ideal 78us. Conv, GN and residual mechanisms untouched.
optimization_strategy.evidence: elementwise_kernel = 15.4% steady, 1858us / 36 launches = 155us per forward for pure layout movement; its DRAM-ideal cost is (134MB for x + 9.4MB for weights)/1.84TB/s = 78us, i.e. ~2x loss from uncoalesced gathers (weight permute reads 4 useful bytes per 36B stride -> wasted sectors). Root cause: TensorIterator writes the output contiguously and gathers the input with stride S (x) or stride 9 (weights), so read sectors are under-utilized. Alternative bottleneck refuted: the conv mainloop at 58.8% runs 77.3 GFLOP in 296us = 261 TFLOPS, above the 223 TFLOPS measured TF32 GEMM rate, so it has no headroom; gn_silu_res_nhwc is already at 90.35% DRAM peak and gn_silu_nhwc at 82.48%, both bandwidth-saturated.
optimization_strategy.expected_metric_change: (1) `elementwise_kernel` steady share drops from 15.4% (1858us) to 0, replaced by transpose_cs_kernel totalling <1000us; (2) the new kernel should show gpu__dram_throughput.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed > 75% and l1tex sector utilization near 100% (vs the gather's ~12% on weights); (3) total forward time 1.242ms -> ~1.16ms, speedup 1.33x -> ~1.42x. ANTI-REGRESSION: launches per forward must stay 11 (3 layout + 2 conv + 2 stats + 2 finalize + 2 gn), gn_silu_res_nhwc must stay ~99us and the sm90_xmma conv time must not move; all four shapes must still pass allclose (the 131x131 tail is the failure mode), and the small 2x256x64x64 shape must not regress since fixed-cost weight transposes dominate there.
optimization_strategy.first_milestone: Step 4 — kernel + launcher + three call-site swaps compile and match the reference on all four shapes including the 131x131 tail.
optimization_strategy.estimated_turns: 13 of ~30 (write ~60 lines: 5 turns; compile/fix: 4; four-shape validation: 4)
